# Unicycler

## Role

Unicycler is a bacterial assembly pipeline for short-read, long-read, and
short-read-first hybrid assembly. In hybrid mode it builds an Illumina graph
and uses long reads to resolve graph paths and repeats.

## Required Inputs

```bash
unicycler -1 reads_R1.fastq.gz -2 reads_R2.fastq.gz \
  -l long_reads.fastq.gz -o assembly_dir -t 8 --mode normal
```

Key outputs are `assembly.fasta`, `assembly.gfa`, and `unicycler.log`.

## Guardrails

Unicycler is designed for bacterial genomes. Read length relative to repeat
length is central: reads must span repeats with enough flanking unique sequence.
`conservative`, `normal`, and `bold` modes trade contiguity against risk of
misassembly; report the chosen mode.
